en.title: Mozart: Eine kleine Nachtmusik, K. 525 – II. Romanze (Andante): A Listening Guide
en.overview: This is a slow movement for string quartet, built around a tune that keeps coming back. Violin 1 probably leads for almost the whole movement. The home key is C major. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so some labels may be off. Listen for the opening tune returning, a darker turn into C minor in the middle, and the tune coming back near the end.

listening_points.headline: The main tune begins in Violin 1
listening_points.text: Violin 1 plays the main theme at the start [m. 0-2]. The home key is C major. After the first measure, the other three instruments accompany the tune [m. 1-3].

listening_points.headline: The tune comes back at once
listening_points.text: The main theme returns at the same pitch [m. 4-6]. The texture at the start of it is a trio [m. 4]. Then the lines become more independent [m. 5]. Part 1 is marked as repeated.

listening_points.headline: A brighter turn to G major
listening_points.text: Part 2 starts in C major [m. 9]. The music then moves to G major [m. 10-13]. Violin 1 plays the main theme in G major [m. 12-14]. The others accompany it.

listening_points.headline: Back to C major, settling down
listening_points.text: The key returns to C major [m. 14]. The lines are independent at first [m. 14]. They then move together in chords at the end of Part 2 [m. 16].

listening_points.headline: A short Part 3 touches G major
listening_points.text: Part 3 is short, only four measures. It starts in C major [m. 17]. It then moves to G major [m. 19-20]. The two violins probably share the lead in [m. 18]. The parts move together in chords at [m. 20].

listening_points.headline: Wandering through A minor and E major
listening_points.text: Part 4 begins in G major [m. 21]. It moves to A minor, a darker key [m. 22-23]. It then moves to E major [m. 24-28]. The music is travelling away from home here.

listening_points.headline: Home in C major, the tune returns twice
listening_points.text: The key returns to C major [m. 29]. Violin 1 plays the main theme [m. 30-32]. It plays it once more [m. 34-36]. Both times it is at the opening pitch.

listening_points.headline: A darker mood in C minor
listening_points.text: Part 5 moves to C minor, a darker key [m. 39-42]. The lines are mostly independent. The analysis marks measure 41 as the loudest or busiest point. No dynamic marking is written there.

listening_points.headline: The minor-key stretch continues
listening_points.text: Part 6 stays in C minor [m. 43-47]. The lines stay independent. The lead is uncertain, but it is probably Violin 1 [m. 43-44]. Violin 1 and Cello may share the lead at [m. 46].

listening_points.headline: Light returns: C major and the tune
listening_points.text: The key brightens to C major [m. 48]. The others accompany Violin 1. The main theme then returns at the opening pitch [m. 50-52].

listening_points.headline: The final section has the tune again
listening_points.text: Section 7 starts with a new key signature [m. 51]. The key is C major. Violin 1 plays the main theme again [m. 54-56]. The texture is a trio at [m. 54].

listening_points.headline: Another visit to G major, then home
listening_points.text: The key moves to G major [m. 60-63]. Violin 1 plays the theme there [m. 62-64]. The music is back in C major from [m. 64].

listening_points.headline: The closing measures
listening_points.text: Measures 66-67 move together in chords. Violin 1 and Viola probably share the lead at [m. 67]. The last measures lean to G major [m. 70-73]. The movement ends in a chordal texture [m. 73].

glossary.explanation: A tune that returns and that you can learn to recognise.
The home note and scale the music is built around. Major keys sound brighter. Minor keys sound darker.
A move from one key to another.
One part plays the tune while the others support it.
All parts move together in chords.
The parts play different lines at the same time.

zh.title: 莫扎特《小夜曲》K. 525 第二乐章 浪漫曲(行板)听赏指南
zh.overview: 这是一首为四件弦乐器写的乐章:第一小提琴、第二小提琴、中提琴和大提琴。主调是C大调。第一小提琴大部分时间带着旋律,其他乐器伴奏,不过这是计算机的估计。请留意开头的主旋律回来了几次,也留意中间调性变暗的一段。本指南中的调性与和弦都是自动估计的,可能有误。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴唱出主旋律
listening_points.text: 乐章一开始,第一小提琴奏出主旋律 [m. 0-2]。其他乐器在下面伴奏。这里是C大调。

listening_points.headline: 主旋律第二次出现
listening_points.text: 主旋律在 [m. 4-6] 原样再现,音高不变。[m. 5] 和 [m. 7] 各声部走各自的线条。

listening_points.headline: 转到G大调,主旋律再来
listening_points.text: 从 [m. 10] 起,音乐估计转入G大调。主旋律在 [m. 12-14] 以同样的音高再次出现。之后 [m. 14] 回到C大调。

listening_points.headline: 短小的一段
listening_points.text: 这一段只有四小节。[m. 19] 起音乐估计又进入G大调。第一小提琴大致领头。

listening_points.headline: 转到A小调
listening_points.text: [m. 22] 起估计进入A小调,和前面的大调相比更暗一些。这几小节里各声部节奏整齐一致。

listening_points.headline: 转到E大调
listening_points.text: [m. 24-28] 估计转入E大调。这一段离开了熟悉的C大调。第一小提琴在这里领头不太确定,可能是几件乐器共享。

listening_points.headline: 回到C大调,主旋律两次再现
listening_points.text: [m. 29] 起回到C大调。主旋律在 [m. 30-32] 和 [m. 34-36] 又出现两次,音高与开头相同。听到熟悉的旋律回来,是很好的路标。

listening_points.headline: 突然转入C小调
listening_points.text: [m. 39] 起估计转入C小调,气氛变暗。这是突然的转换。这里各声部大多走独立的线条。分析估计最响、最忙的点在 [m. 41],但谱上没有力度记号。

listening_points.headline: 小调继续,各声部线条交错
listening_points.text: C小调一直持续到 [m. 47]。[m. 43-45] 各声部走独立线条。这里第一小提琴的领头把握不大,可能是共享的。

listening_points.headline: 回到C大调,主旋律再度出现
listening_points.text: [m. 48] 回到C大调。主旋律在 [m. 50-52] 和 [m. 54-56] 再次出现。[m. 51] 起是新的谱号调号段落。

listening_points.headline: G大调里的主旋律,再回C大调
listening_points.text: [m. 60-63] 音乐估计进入G大调,主旋律在 [m. 62-64] 以同样的音高出现。随后 [m. 64] 回到C大调。

listening_points.headline: 尾声
listening_points.text: [m. 66-67] 各声部节奏整齐,是主调织体(旋律配和声)。[m. 70] 起估计为G大调,直到结尾。最后 [m. 73] 也是整齐的和声。

glossary.explanation: 乐章开头第一小提琴奏出的那条旋律,后面会多次回来。
一段音乐的“中心音”和色彩。大调通常明亮,小调通常较暗。
音乐从一个调换到另一个调。
几件乐器节奏基本一致,像一起唱同一首歌的和声。
一件乐器奏旋律,其他乐器在下面伴奏。
各声部各走各的旋律线,互相交织。
